Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses TERMS & CONDITIONS FOR COMPLETE RTO REGISTRATION OF GARBAGE E-CARTS 1. Scope of Work The Contractor/Vendor shall be responsible for completing the entire Regional Transport Office (RTO) regis tration process for all garbage e-carts supplied under the tender, from preparation and submission of docu ments up to obtaining the applicable registration certificate/registration number and related statutory doc uments. The scope shall include, but shall not be limited to: 1. Preparation, verification and compilation of all documents required for RTO registration. 2. Coordination with the concerned RTO/ARTO office. 3. Submission of registration applications and supporting documents. 4. Payment/processing of applicable statutory registration fees, as agreed under the tender. 5. Handling of inspection/verification of the vehicle, wherever required. 6. Coordination for chassis/vehicle verification, if applicable. 7. Processing of temporary/permanent registration, as applicable. 8. Obtaining the Registration Certificate (RC) and/or digital RC. 9. Obtaining and providing the registration number/number plate as applicable. 10. Completion of all necessary RTO formalities, corrections, resubmissions and follow-up. 11. Providing copies of all registration-related documents to the Purchaser/Department. 12. Any other reasonable activity required for successful completion of the RTO registration process. 2. Responsibility of Contractor

The Contractor shall take full responsibility for completion of the RTO registration process within the prescr ibed period. The Contractor shall ensure that all applications, forms, declarations and documents submitted to the RTO are accurate, complete and valid. Any delay arising due to incorrect, incomplete or defective documentation attributable to the Contractor s hall be rectified by the Contractor at its own .
